subject.title: Feature: Inject context window % into system prompt runtime section

question: Should OpenClaw expose passive context-window usage in the system-prompt Runtime line, and should the display be percentage-only or include raw used/window tokens?
rationale: The source path is clear, but this changes volatile model-facing prompt metadata and cache semantics, so automation should not choose the prompt contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded Runtime metadata
options.body: Add a small context field below the cache boundary using only fresh or explicitly documented previous-turn usage, with tests for stale, compaction, and model-switch cases.

options.title: Keep explicit inspection only
options.body: Leave context usage on `/context`, `/status`, and `session_status`, then close or update this issue once maintainers decide passive prompt metadata is not desired.

options.title: Fold into runtime self-context
options.body: Keep this issue open as dependent on the broader runtime self-context design rather than landing a narrow Runtime-line primitive now.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded Runtime metadata
recommendation.body: Add a small context field below the cache boundary using only fresh or explicitly documented previous-turn usage, with tests for stale, compaction, and model-switch cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest history match for the Runtime prompt path and the likely owner for the prompt-contract decision.
